# Feature illustrations

Generated on 2026-10-13 with the built-in imagegen tool for the three feature panels. These are illustrative scenes, not photographs of IT Global equipment or customers.

Final assets and prompts:

## data-control.png

Asset type: one standalone illustration for a premium Russian business software website feature panel, landscape 1216x1040 pixels, ratio 1.17:1. Style: photorealistic studio product photography of carefully art-directed tactile objects, the polished material realism of a high-end 3D product render. Quiet warm ivory seamless background, matte cream ceramic, brushed silver metal, very restrained muted sage and terracotta orange accents. Broad soft daylight from upper left, realistic contact shadows, natural perspective, clean spacious composition with a few large readable forms. Main objects centered and fully visible inside a 12 percent safe margin, occupy about 70 percent of frame. Background goes all the way to edges, no border or rounded frame (the webpage clips it). No lettering, no numbers, no price tags, no watermarks, no real or invented brand marks, no tiny labels. No neon, no dark cybersecurity imagery, no glowing wires, no floating holograms, no ornamental particle effects. Scene: data belongs to the customer, stored on their own server. A beautifully designed compact silver two-bay office NAS / private server resting on a low warm-white pedestal, with two discreet green status LEDs. Beside it three thick cream document folders and one frosted-glass solid shield with a small understated orange checkmark inset. Include a small metal physical key at the base to suggest ownership and access. One coherent grounded still-life, clear silhouette, three-quarter view from slightly above, short normal lens rather than isometric diagram. Not a giant data center. No humans. The server is the primary focal point, folders secondary. The image should feel calm, trustworthy and tangible.
